assessment_basis: Source audit in Sources/FOKSTerminalApp and Sources/FOKSTerminalCore
Live command verification for metrics (vm_stat, memory_pressure, df -k /, sysctl -n hw.memsize)
Current documented scope in README.md and docs/NEXT_GENERATION_ARCHITECTURE.md
scope.notes: Statuses are evidence-based from code/test/runtime checks; not every UI interaction was manually clicked in this pass.

features.name: Native macOS app packaging (.app)
features.reasoning: scripts/build_app.sh builds dist/FOKSTerminal.app; Info.plist validates and binary is arm64 Mach-O. App is launchable via open and process appears in pgrep.
features.conclusion: Fully operational for local packaging and launch

features.name: Read-only execution model
features.reasoning: No auto-fix code path exists; Run Check executes explicit ReadOnlyCheck only. CommandRunner blocks shell trampolines and non-absolute executables.
features.conclusion: Fully operational safety model for non-destructive behavior

features.name: Dashboard module
features.reasoning: Dashboard section exists in NavigationSplitView and displays health, issues, incidents, AI summary, project overview, and trend tile.

features.name: Projects Center module
features.reasoning: Projects list + detail pane implemented with health, git fields, dirty preview, last activity, missing dependencies, warnings.

features.name: System Center module
features.reasoning: Shows CPU, memory, disk, network, uptime, hardware, process watchlist, LaunchAgents and LaunchDaemons tables.

features.name: Logs Center module
features.reasoning: Search/filter UI implemented for severity, category, project, time window; only actionable logs shown by default filter.

features.name: Action Center module
features.reasoning: ActionCenterBuilder prioritizes critical/warning/info actions from launchd/project/system/log state and renders cards.

features.name: Fix Queue module
features.reasoning: Manual command cards are typed (binary + args + intent) with copy buttons; Run Check exists and uses ReadOnlyCheck.

features.name: Daily Ops Report module
features.reasoning: DailyReportView generates Markdown or plain-text report and supports clipboard copy.

features.name: Project inventory loading from config/projects.json
features.reasoning: ProjectConfigLoader now returns only configured enabled projects; test verifies no invented fallback projects when config missing.

features.name: Git repository health analysis
features.reasoning: Uses git status/branch/remote/upstream/divergence/last commit and computes health + warnings; parser tests pass.

features.name: Dirty file inspection
features.reasoning: Parses porcelain status into dirty counts/items and displays them in project detail and actions.

features.name: Branch ahead/behind monitoring
features.reasoning: Reader executes rev-list --left-right --count and surfaces ahead/behind in project state/report/actions.

features.name: Missing project detection
features.reasoning: Filesystem existence check marks project as MISSING and generates critical action/incident.

features.name: Missing dependency detection
features.reasoning: DependencyInspector uses heuristic markers (node_modules, .venv, etc.) and warning hints only. It does not perform language-specific dependency graph checks.

features.name: CPU metrics
features.reasoning: Computed from ps %cpu normalized by logical cores; availability handling prevents fake 0% when command fails.

features.name: Memory metrics accuracy
features.reasoning: Patched to use memory_pressure free% primary path, vm_stat fallback corrected; tests added for both parsers and recent live check confirmed previous inflation issue resolved.

features.name: Disk metrics accuracy
features.reasoning: df -k / parsing returns used% and free bytes; live check matched tile (18% and ~55 GB free). Nil returned for malformed output.

features.name: Network metrics
features.reasoning: Reads cumulative netstat byte counters (received/transmitted), not throughput/rate over time.

features.name: Uptime metrics
features.reasoning: Reads uptime command and uses availability flag when unavailable.

features.name: Process monitoring
features.reasoning: Process list is watch-term filtered (not full process inventory) and capped, by design for operational signal.

features.name: LaunchAgent inspection
features.reasoning: launchctl list + launchctl print analysis implemented with state/health/reason extraction and failure detection.

features.name: LaunchDaemon inspection
features.reasoning: Discovery is filtered to relevant labels and runtime print attempted; not a full daemon inventory.

features.name: Incident aggregation
features.reasoning: IncidentAggregator builds incidents from missing projects, failed launch services, severe logs, and critical system pressure.

features.name: Operational scoring (global/system/project)
features.reasoning: Scoring models are implemented and now return 0 on unavailable system snapshot instead of false healthy default.

features.name: Trend tracking
features.reasoning: trendPoints exist in-memory (capped to 96 refreshes) but no persistence across app restarts.

features.name: Ollama local AI integration (127.0.0.1:11434)
features.reasoning: LocalAIAdvisor sends diagnostic bundle via HTTP to Ollama and handles HTTP/error/empty-response paths; Analyze provider dropdown keeps local Ollama as default and shows the local model picker.
features.conclusion: Fully operational (depends on local Ollama runtime/model availability)

features.name: Launch-time local AI and Cloudflare Tunnel startup
features.reasoning: StartupServiceManager checks/starts Ollama first, then checks/starts the named Cloudflare Tunnel from config/startup_services.json. The dashboard renders visible status rows and failures when binaries or tunnel configuration are missing.
features.conclusion: Operational with explicit local config and no stored Cloudflare credentials

features.name: Cloud AI analysis selector
features.reasoning: Analyze now includes a Local AI / Cloud AI dropdown. CloudAIAdvisor requires FOKS_CLOUD_AI_ENDPOINT, FOKS_CLOUD_AI_API_KEY, and FOKS_CLOUD_AI_MODEL, requires HTTPS, and fails before sending when configuration is missing or invalid.
features.conclusion: Operational as an explicit opt-in cloud path with no stored API keys

features.name: AI safety constraints (advisory only)
features.reasoning: Provider-specific prompts explicitly forbid destructive/auto-exec suggestions; app has no path from AI output to execution.

features.name: Clipboard exports (commands/reports/AI/check output)
features.reasoning: Copy actions exist for manual commands, daily report, AI report, and check report via NSPasteboard.

features.name: Keyboard shortcuts
features.reasoning: Refresh and report copy shortcuts are present, but broader shortcut coverage across modules is limited.

features.name: Accessibility support
features.reasoning: Uses native SwiftUI controls and scalable font setting, but no dedicated accessibility audit artifacts (VoiceOver labels, contrast audit, nav-only flow tests) are present.

features.name: Data integrity policy (no fake data)
features.reasoning: Hardcoded hardware profile removed; no synthetic missing-log records; failed metric reads display unavailable; tests cover no fallback projects and unavailable metric behavior.

features.name: Cloud/service dependency avoidance
features.reasoning: Local Ollama remains the default. Cloud analysis exists only behind explicit user selection and environment configuration, with no stored API keys or remote backend dependency required for normal operation.
features.conclusion: Fully operational for local-first default operation

features.name: Autonomous fixes / destructive actions
features.reasoning: Not implemented by design to preserve read-only safety model; no code paths for mutation/fix orchestration.

features.name: Persistent historical analytics/trends
features.reasoning: Architecture doc explicitly states trend persistence is future work; current trend is in-memory only.

features.name: Structured timestamp normalization across all log formats
features.reasoning: Architecture notes that not all log formats are timestamp-parsed; read-time is used when structured time is absent.

features.name: User-editable project inventory in UI
features.reasoning: Config is file-based only; no in-app editor flow currently implemented.

features.name: Signed/notarized distribution pipeline
features.reasoning: Current packaging is local ad hoc .app build; no signing/notarization flow in scripts/docs.

summary.overall_assessment: Core operational command-center functionality is implemented and functioning. Remaining gaps are mostly persistence/depth enhancements (historical trends, exhaustive daemon/process/log normalization, richer accessibility/shortcuts) and intentional omissions aligned with read-only safety.
